featuredQuote.text: The Editorial Board wasn't just a club—it was a movement that transformed students into storytellers, thinkers, and change-makers.
featuredQuote.author: Dr. Anil Verma

testimonials.quote: Being a part of The Editorial Board refined my clarity of thought and expression. It taught me how to structure ideas, communicate responsibly, and create content that truly resonates with readers beyond the page.

EDB became a space where I learned confidence through words. From brainstorming to final drafts, every experience strengthened my voice and taught me how storytelling can influence, inform, and inspire change.

My journey with The Editorial Board trained me to think critically and write responsibly. It wasn’t just about content creation, but about understanding the impact of well-researched and ethical journalism.
EDB helped me grow as a communicator and collaborator. The exposure to diverse perspectives and teamwork sharpened my ability to present ideas clearly and creatively across different platforms.
testimonials.personTitle: Final Year Member • Electronics & Communication Engineering

testimonials.quote: The Editorial Board gave me a creative outlet alongside academics. It strengthened my confidence, improved my articulation, and taught me how thoughtful writing can leave a lasting impact.

testimonials.quote: My time at EDB shaped my approach to writing and analysis. I learned consistency, discipline, and how meaningful content emerges from patience and perspective.
